deletion.unknown: We could not confirm the request outcome. It may already be queued. Retry uses the same request; do not start a new deletion.
deletion.rejected: The server changed or deletion was refused. Close this dialog, refresh, and confirm again if you still want to delete it.
deletion.busy: The server can't be deleted at the moment. Please try again later
deletion.signIn: Sign in again before deleting a server.
deletion.unavailable: Deletion is unavailable while this server is suspended or already being deleted.
